title: 伊曼纽尔：资本主义需要改革，腐败是毒瘤
speaker: Rahm Emanuel

segments.en: And the wing of my party rather believes that cap the problem with capitalism Is capitalism i think they're wrong. I believe in the free market
segments.zh: 而我党内的部分人认为，资本主义的问题在于资本主义本身。我认为他们错了。我信仰自由市场。

segments.en: But it needs fundamental reform to rid the stench of rampant corruption both in the political process the economy and in our tax code
segments.zh: 但它需要根本性改革，以消除政治进程、经济和税法中普遍腐败的恶臭。

segments.en: All of it is leading to an inexcusable level of inequality Do you think being pro-capitalism in the democratic party right now is an argument that's going to resonate with democratic voters
segments.zh: 这一切导致了不可接受的不平等程度。你认为现在在民主党内支持资本主义的论点能引起民主党选民的共鸣吗？

segments.en: Well, it's what I believe so I might as well tell people the truth And if you want to go somewhere else the Socialism has never created a viable economic model or viable middle class
segments.zh: 嗯，这就是我所相信的，所以我不妨告诉人们真相。如果你想去别处，社会主义从未创造过可行的经济模式或可行的中产阶级。

segments.en: There are parts of the party they want to go social and I happen to think the people that are in LA or New York they're not socialists. They're angry at a system
segments.zh: 党内有一部分人想走社会主义道路，而我碰巧认为洛杉矶或纽约的人不是社会主义者。他们是对一个体制感到愤怒。

segments.en: That they played by and they can't get ahead Tuesday is not better than Monday next week will never be better than this week and next year They'll never going to get out of the their parents basement or out of a four person one bedroom apartment
segments.zh: 他们遵守规则却无法前进。周二不比周一好，下周永远不会比这周好，明年他们永远无法搬出父母的地下室或四人一居室的公寓。

segments.en: And they have every region to be angry. I do believe in the three market I don't believe the corruption you're seeing is Right, I think as I said in that speech corruption is a cancer on capitalism it's core
segments.zh: 他们完全有理由愤怒。我确实相信市场，我不认为你看到的腐败是正确的，正如我在那次演讲中所说，腐败是资本主义的癌症，是核心问题。
